purpose: Independently train two amplitude parameters on original source training responses and compare with complete code-weight fitting.
scope: All six retained exposed R20 development queries. No original test data. Same frozen source axes, target reader, geometric supports and output-KL plus direction penalty. Matched64 uses the old full fitter optimizer settings and sampled rows; stronger256 uses four times the update budget and ten times the learning rate, with both reported and no held-data selection. This is an attribution experiment on development data, not a new independent confirmation.

variants.geometric_learned_norm: geometric direction rescaled to the norm of the fitted direction for each sign
variants.functional_original_norm: fitted direction rescaled to the original geometric norm for each sign
